title: When the focused control inside a focus trap removes itself, focus must stay inside the trap
summary: Pressing a Show all button that removes itself drops keyboard focus to the page body behind the open dialog.
consumer: Author-written store search page around the unchanged upstream ES module index.js at buggyCommit; its tabbable dependency is the unchanged tabbable v6.1.2 src/index.js (MIT) in upstream-dependency/, resolved with an import map.
